piano_rolls.purpose: Walkable, spline-meshable piano-key paths laid over water or land.
placement_notes: Use SplineMeshComponent on a BP_DreamPath spline. Cap_Start/End close both ends.
Arcs span 90/180 with radius 400cm; can be tiled for tighter turns.
Ramps rise 15/30 degrees over 200cm; use for height changes between two piano paths.

coral_reef.purpose: Instanced scatter for water-floor dressing. Reads against Oceanology water V7.
placement_notes: Drive scatter with PCG: 3 branching + 2 plate + 1 brain per 5m x 5m tile.
Sea whips go near path edges (piano roll approach lanes).
Color by palette: warm near sandy shallows, cool in deeper water, pearl in the highlight zone.

filigree.purpose: Modular musical-ornament trim that frames piano roll paths and accents coral formations.
placement_notes: SplineMeshComponent on a 1m inset spline along the piano path; trim follows the path.
Inside corners hug the path; outside corners extend 60cm outward as accent.
SheetMusicCorner anchors a 60x60cm staff-and-clef at path junctions.

convention: All MIs inherit from existing toon-family instances. M_Master_Toon_Universal is NOT modified.
